title: Finite-pushforward embeddings over a field
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme of finite type over a field [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $F$ be a constructible sheaf of $\mathbf Z/N$-modules on the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], with the finite coefficient ring $\mathbf Z/N$ as in that definition. There are finitely many finite maps $h_i:Y_i\to X$, finite abelian groups $M_i$ killed by $N$, and an injective map of $\mathbf Z/N$-module sheaves
$$F\longrightarrow\bigoplus_i(h_i)_*\underline M_i.$$
Here $\underline M_i$ is the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] with its $\mathbf Z/N$-module structure, and direct images have the meaning of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image].

proof.text: The spectrum of a field is locally Noetherian. Apply [pqf-lem-locnoeth-lft] to the structure map to make $X$ locally Noetherian. Its quasi-compactness, supplied by finite type in [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and compactness of the field spectrum make $X$ compact. Thus $X$ is Noetherian.

Put $\Lambda=\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbf Z/N)$. Since $N\ne 0$, this is a finite commutative ring and hence Noetherian. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison] to the given finite-value constructibility witness, obtaining the source-library IsConstructibleSheaf instance for $F$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-finite-pushforward-noetherian] to $X,F,\Lambda$. It gives a finite family of finite maps, finitely generated $\Lambda$-modules and the required monomorphism of module sheaves.

For each index, a finitely generated module over the finite ring $\Lambda$ is finite as a set (Mathlib Module.finite_of_finite). Retain exactly the same finite maps, modules, monomorphism and Mono proof, replacing only the module-finiteness witnesses by set-finiteness witnesses. The empty index family and zero ring $N=1$ are allowed without a case restriction.
